claims.citation: New York Herald, 14 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship D H Watjen (Brem), Julicher, Leghorn, 55[?] days, with
marble, rags, &c, to Chas Luling[?] & Co. May 27, lat 34 20, lon
52 17, picked up a box containing four cans of petroleum,
marked with a diamond and letter Y; 28th, lat 34 17, lon 53 15,
saw a schr, about 100 tons, waterlogged and abandoned.
